description: This Java class parses XML feeds from stackoverflow.com, extracting entries with title, link, and summary.

classes.name: StackOverflowXmlParser
classes.description: A parser class for processing XML feeds from StackOverflow, extracting entries with title, link, and summary.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a single post entry in the XML feed with title, link, and summary.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an InputStream containing XML data and returns a list of entries.

methods.name: readFeed
methods.description: Reads the feed element and extracts all entry elements.

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Reads an individual entry element and extracts title, link, and summary.

methods.name: readTitle
methods.description: Extracts the text from a title tag.

methods.name: readLink
methods.description: Extracts the href attribute from a link tag with rel='alternate'.

methods.name: readSummary
methods.description: Extracts the text from a summary tag.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Extracts text content from the current element.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips over tags that are not of interest, handling nested tags.
